label: Successive halving
subgoals: Start every configuration at the smallest budget
Keep the best one over eta at each rung
Multiply the survivors' budget by eta

label: Counting the cost
subgoals: Multiply survivors by budget at each rung
Sum the rungs for the total cost
Divide the full-budget cost by the total

label: When early results mislead
subgoals: Measure rank correlation between early and final metrics
Keep more survivors when the correlation is weak
Track a Pareto front when objectives conflict
